parameters.content:
## NWI - BC Customers -> HubSpot companies (daily): set up before publishing
1. Connect credentials: **HubSpot Service Key account** (companies read/write) and **Business Central – NWI Group (client credentials)**. Confirm no "not connected" warning on any node.
2. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler (not set in this file). Settings -> Timezone: Australia/Sydney, so midnight means midnight Sydney.
3. BC web service **Customer_Card** (page 21) must stay published (Segment, ABN, Invoice Email etc. are page-only).
4. HubSpot company property `business_central_id` holds the BC customer number and is how a record is matched. Segment / Responsibility Center / Location Code are HubSpot dropdowns: a BC value HubSpot does not list fails that batch.
5. **Workflow Config** holds the lookback window (25h = daily run + 1h overlap), batch size and the BC-field -> HubSpot-property map.

**What it does:** finds BC customers created or changed in the last 25 hours, finds the matching HubSpot companys by `business_central_id`, and updates only the properties whose value differs. BC wins. A blank in BC never clears HubSpot. HubSpot records are never created. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: Every Day At Midnight
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at midnight (set the workflow timezone to Australia/Sydney). Production runs only - publish the workflow.

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: lookbackHours: how far back to look (25 = daily run + 1h overlap). matchProperty: HubSpot property holding the BC number. fieldMap: BC field -> HubSpot property.

nodes.name: List Changed BC Customers
nodes.notes: One call: every customer created or modified in the window.

nodes.name: Build BC Read Batches
nodes.notes: Splits the customer numbers into batches (batchSize each). One item per batch.

nodes.name: Read BC Customer Details
nodes.notes: One call per batch: all the fields we sync, for up to batchSize customers.

nodes.name: Find Matching Companies
nodes.notes: Read-only search (POST is only the HubSpot search convention): one call finds the HubSpot records for a whole batch.

nodes.name: Compare And Build Updates
nodes.notes: Keeps only properties that differ. Blank BC values are ignored. No changes = no output, so the next node does not run.

nodes.name: Update HubSpot Companies
nodes.notes: Batch update, up to 100 companies per call. Updates only: records are never created. Setting the same value twice is harmless, so retry is safe.

parameters.content:
## 1. Find changed BC customers
One call lists everything created or modified in the lookback window.

## 2. Find the HubSpot records
BC details in one call per batch, matching companies in one search.

## 3. Write only what changed
Compares BC to HubSpot and updates up to 100 records per call.
